title: Annotatio IV §.III (2): Spiritual effects follow only spiritual presence — not corporal or oral
pass_a_gloss: (2) Because that presence and participation of Christ’s flesh and blood alone are commended, which spiritual Union and Communion with Christ and eternal life itself and raising from the dead by Christ unto it certainly and infallibly follow … But these Spiritual, Supernatural and Celestial effects adhere inseparably and necessarily only to Spiritual Presence and Participation of Christ, not to Corporal or Oral — as is confessed, and as is clear from the sacramental, even oral, eating of the unworthy which on the Lutheran hypothesis is empty of the spiritual.
pass_b_english: (2) The presence and participation recommended are those which spiritual union with Christ, eternal life, and the last-day raising infallibly follow (John 6:53–56).
Those heavenly effects cling only to spiritual presence and participation — not corporal or oral; even on the Lutheran view the unworthy’s oral eating is spiritually empty.
source_text: (2) Quia ista duntaxat cùm præsentia, tùm participatio carnis & sanguinis Christi, commendantur, quas certò & infallibiliter spiritualis cum Christo Unio & Communio ipsaque vita æterna & ad hanc à Christo exsuscitatio è mortuis, insequuntur: Nam sic pergit Salvator vers. 53. 54. 55. 56. Amen Amen dico vobis, nisi ederitis carnem Filii hominis & biberitis ejus Sanguinem, non habebitis vitam in vobis. Qui edit carnem meam & bibit meum sanguinem, habet vitam æternam, & ego suscitabo ipsum ultimo illo die. Caro enim mea verè est cibus & sanguis meus verè est potus, qui edit meam carnem & bibit meum sanguinem, in me manet & ego in eo. At effectus hi Spirituales, Supernaturales & Cælestes, non nisi Spirituali Christi Præsentiæ & Participationi, indivisim ac necessariò adhærent, non Corporali aut Orali, uti in confesso est, & ex indignorum manducatione sacramentali quidem, etiam orali, ex Lutheranorum hypothesi, at spiritualis vacua, liquidò constat.
